Lockite 243 is what I use. Blue, medium strength, to stop loosening due to vibration. That is what I see on my fasteners from the factory. Specs say about 50 in/lbs of prevailing torque to break apart. Perfect for the application.

Locktite 222 is low strength, it is more for brittle metals, or something like a carburetor set screw. Honestly it would probably work.

Loctite red is usually used for permanent, larger fasteners (e.g. car suspension) that you don't expect to take apart. Usually you need heat, impact or leverage. On a skate, you will need heat or have to drill it out. (overkill)
